questions: When the board is fully in view, are there exactly three pens on it (no missing pen and no empty gap)?
Do all three pens point the same direction, with none flipped or reversed relative to the other two?
Are all three pens the same color as each other, with none differing in color?
Is every pen complete and capped, with none showing a bare/exposed writing tip or looking clearly shorter than the others?
Does the board move smoothly and continuously from left to right, without stopping, freezing, pausing, reversing, or jamming at any point?

question_answers.evidence: When the board is fully centered (e.g., at 00:13), exactly three pens are visible.
All three pens are oriented vertically with the black cap/grip at the bottom and the barrel at the top.
All three pens have identical black caps/grips and translucent grey barrels.
All pens appear to have their caps on and are of equal length.
The board moves from left to center, then stops completely and remains stationary from approximately 00:14 to 00:21 before moving again to the right.

parsed.reason: The board pauses and remains stationary in the center of the frame for several seconds (approx 00:14-00:21) instead of moving smoothly and continuously.

description: The board pauses mid-travel, then continues.
